nom: Naturium Vitamin Bright Illuminating Eye Cream

avis.texte: I love the texture, the scent, and the effect! Not even a week in and I'm already a fan.
I wanted to like this eye cream, but am not thrilled about it. It is a bit drying and stings the eyes. Have not noticed a change underneath my eyes. Disappointing.

I cannot buy this product as I am allergic to radishes, of all things. Why have companies decided to put Leuconostoc/Radish Root Ferment Filtrate in skin care products? I am good with other vegetables like eggplant and onions and other roots like carrots, turmeric, ginger. Not sure about turnips as I do not believe I have ever eaten one!
I can't really tell much of a diff yet and it's been 2 weeks, maybe it just takes awhile to show any changes

I completely love this eye cream. I wear it during the day before going to the gym and it makes my aura look bright. I tend to have dry skin around my eyes and this has helped that a lot. I enjoy that it can be worn by itself or under my make up. Great texture
Great eye cream: love the glass jar and creamy texture. My undereye area is moisturized and non-greasy after using.

I love how clean and moisturizing it feels under my eyes, and how it brightens my dark circles. It works great with makeup and even better without! It's definitely my go-to for no-makeup days when I want to keep my look fresh and natural.
Love the feel of this and I feel like it makes me dark circles just the tiniest bit lighter, which whatever, I'll take what I can get

Just purchased this eye cream a couple weeks ago and it unfortunately irritates my eyes. I don't typically have a reaction to new products but this one definitely made my eyes icky and left red bumps wear the product was applied
A wonderful eye cream. It actually brightens and lightens my dark circles. ❤️ love it!

I am 57yo with fine lines around my eyes. I won't wear concealers because they ALL make lines more apparent. I've wasted money on many types. This brightens and does not show lines! I use the darker shade do a hint of subtle color. Love it!

I tried to love this product really, but wasted my money. No matter what I do, it always pills, put it on dry skin, on top of another serum, pills. Plus the glitter ended up highlighting my under eye, which is the opposite of what I want.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I love this eye cream I only had it for a few weeks but I already see improvements! Would definitely recommend to others!

I love this eye cream. This is the first eye cream that I've used that I noticed instant improvement. It blends into my skin for a natural finish with a little shimmer. It does not irritate the delicate skin around my eyes and again it looks so natural. It only takes a little amount but a little goes a long way.

I brought this product about a month or so ago. Love the texture very smooth and lightweight but did not correct my dark circles like I was expecting. I'll by it again because I again love the texture around my eyes.
Love how my eyes look even with still looking tired. I work night shift so this helps a lot.

the reviews make this product seem sketchy but i tried and maybe i'm delusional but i saw a difference! i personally love it. this product is great for brightening when you don't want to wear concealer!

Love the consistency of the eye cream. However for medium/deep color, I need a bit more deep tint to it. I mix it with a small amount of Naturium tinted moisturizing sunblock to get the look that i prefer.

avis.titre: Naturium eye brightening cream in light-medium
avis.texte: I agree with most of the other negative reviews about this product. my skin is more light than medium so the banana color should have brightened my under eye area but it didn't, like others it just disappeared. then when I put it on it was thick, shiny, and pilled under my makeup. I never used this as a concealer or color corrector, so maybe layering all this products on top didn't agree with the cream, but when I used it alone while sleeping, if I rubbed my eye, which when using this product happened a lot, it just rolled up in balls and flaked off. not good in my opinion. I feel that after an hour of wearing it should absorb. I think they wanted this product to brighten and "blur" but it doesn't, it just pills horribly with any pressure when applying makeup or touching your under eye area.
This is the best! Its like adding your highlight and eyecream at the same time. I don't wear makeup, so this is perfect for the discoloration under my eyes when I dont sleep well.
I love this eye cream. Great under concealer. Not greasy & just the right amount of bright.

I'm a middle-aged woman with combo skin and sun damage. I had eczema under my left eye for the longest time. I've been to the dermatologist numerous times but nothing helped. until this. I bought it because I saw a TikTok and figured, "Why not?", and I'm very glad I did. I love this stuff. it's very moisturizing and clean. it gives a bit of shimmer to help with my undereye bags. I'll keep buying it unless the recipe changes. I also have the facial lotion with sunscreen, but that's a different review.
I love how this eye cream glides on my undereye area gently. I just found these beautifully formulated products and have been loving every one I've purchased
I was hoping this would be somewhat of a dupe for the ole henricksen banana bright eye cream…but just doesn't compare. And its sparkly?
I like this so far! I did get a milia under my eye after using but that often happens to me with thicker eye creams. I do think it makes my dark circles look better

avis.titre: Eye shimmer-natural look and a bonus eye cream!
avis.texte: I love the shimmer it brings to my eyes. It's just enough that I don't need to add any make up. I'd rather be adding more eye cream than makeup with shimmer.

The consistency is strange and the "glow" that it leaves behind doesnt cover up anything but does leave a glittery finish that does not look attractive, if anything it made by dark circles stand out more 😂

Love the consistency of this eye cream and that it can be applied all around the eyes. It also seems to provide a very slight brightening effect for my dark circles immediately. I am hoping it will provide long term brightening effects with consistent use.

The picture of the bottle has significantly more product than what you actually get. The product itself burns your eyes. Caused redness and swelling also. I threw it away after a few tries of using it.
My under eyes used to never be bad until I started using this product, it literally made it worse and wasn't very moisturizing. Also, the color would just disappear.

I love this eye cream. Been using for almost a year and see great benefits. My eyes are hydrated, my bags have (slightly) disappeared. Really great product. It does have a bit of a shimmer to it, which could be helpful to know before buying. I find it subtle and flattering. May not be for everyone

I've tried so many Naturium products and when Naturium nails it, they really nail it. But this eye cream is a miss for me. Like other products I didn't enjoy, this was a texture issue. Within a week of opening it, the cream has separated like natural peanut butter, with a layer of oil rising to the top. I guess I could keep it in the fridge, but I also don't find it particularly moisturizing or plumping.

Am I using this wrong?! I'm the only person to not be in love with this. I initially tried it on and saw some brightening and was excited and hopeful that with continued use my desk circles would diminish or even disappear. With my first use i took a tiny dab on my pinky and gently spread, and saw some brightness and was excited, but within a minute or so my eyes started tearing, more left eye than right, but both crying. I didn't feel any itchiness or discomfort so I chalked it up that maybe I applied too close to my waterline and just wiped with atissue, but the crying persisted for some hours after. Repeat EVERY TIME I put this on! It's come to the point that I reach for it less, maybe once a week or when I have important video calls and need a little brightening, but the tearing is just an unlucky side effect, so the cute points i gained from less dark circle is lost by having tear streaks or irritated looking eyes. The container is small but since a little goes a long way I knew this would last forever, but now that I can't comfortably wear it often, it'll take even longer and I now feel wasteful. Stuck between a rock and hard place - i see a bit of a benefit, but it comes at such a weird cost.

I usually have issues with eye creams but this one has played well with my other skincare and doesnt irritate my skin like a lot of other eye creams do. I dont see any color correcting or anything but it is hydrating

If you have dry under eyes, this is a must! Its very hydrating and feels luxurious. I was previously using the It Cosmetics Confidence In An Eye Cream and made the switch to this. The tint is more of a pearl-like reflector that makes my dark circles less noticeable. Again, the tint doesn't conceal my dark circles completely, but it does tone down the darkness a bit. I think this is a great product and you cannot beat the price point.

This was an accidental purchase. It's definitely very brightening and hydrating under the eyes. However, I'm 45 I'm not trying to brighten under my eyes. I gave it to a much younger family member and she loves it!
such a great cream my dark eye going away but my eye getting sting , may be my eye so sensitive 40+ Asian brown skin
Very irritating to eyes. Very strange consistency, watery. And what was the color about? Did nothing! Disappointing as it sounded like air would be a good product!

I ordered this eye cream a few months ago. By the time it arrived, I was in the hospital having major surgery. I was hospitalized for weeks and had a slow recovery once I came home. Because of this, I just opened my purchase a few days ago. I was excited to try this new eye cream and believed it would cheer me up while also making my undereye area look better. Unfortunately, the jar had leaked and there was an oily substance everywhere in the little box that the jar came in. The jar itself was slick with the oily substance also. When I opened the jar, I was surprised and sad to see that it was mostly empty (not even half a jar full). The cream inside was more dry than creamy. I was so hopeful about this purchase! I would like to believe this was an isolated incident and not the norm for this company. I looked at reviews before ordering this product and thought ordering the eye cream would be great idea. Again, this was a huge disappointment!

I stopped using eye cream a while ago when none of them seem to do anything more than my moisturizer and my dermatologist said to stick with the moisturizer. I decided to try this eye cream and it is beyond anything I could've hoped for. It doesn't cover my circles, but it leaves a beautiful surface for concealer and any faint lines have disappeared due to the plumping. I love it. My only complaint was that the jar was not full at all.

I want to replace my go to eyecream Origins and thought this would be a good replacement. I noticed when I first opened it looked used already. I applied some on my under eyes at night to see if it would be good for under makeup and immediately no, its thick and doesn't absorb I also didnt notice any brightening effect like I do with Origins. When I woke up I had tiny break outs around my eyes so now I have to try and repair that. Not worth it.

Each time I've used the vitamin bright eye cream, my skin has burned.. quite painfully. I thought it would be temporary, but this last time, it made a red swollen welt under my eye. It's safe to say I gave it a fair try. I must be allergic or something in it isn't good for my skin.
Don't bother unless you like a gold sheen under your eyes. If you want to cover dark circles this is not for you.

I found this to be brightening and very hydrating for my under eyes. It is on the richer side for an eye cream, not extremely rich but definitely not a watery thin formula. It worked well under makeup for me. My undereyes are not very dry so I typically use a thin eye cream (such as the Inkey List eye creams) under makeup, but this worked as well. Would be excellent for people with dry undereyes! Really does brighten too, the tint is as pictured, and has extremely fine shimmer in the formula to add to the brightening effect. Not noticeable unless you get super close to the face.

these products as helped my circulation and reduced my dark circles I got from work, as far as the pigments it dosent really cover them, but it makes them reflective so it's less noticeable. but the vitman k Has really reduced them alot.

I really wanted to love this product as it seemed like it could be a dupe for the more expensive Ole Henriksen eye cream. I used it a few times and it was fine. I didnt really notice any dofference bewtween when I used it or didnt. However, after just a few uses the textire started to change. It became oily, and goopy. A clear oily liquid had seperated from the orange cream and sat on top of the product. I tries mixing it back together but it continued to seperate. I havent been brave enough to use it again

Very moisturizing on the eye and really helps hide dark circles. Almost like a concealer in the way it brightens the under eyes. Only reason i give it a 4 is because it doesn't really do anything for fine lines and wrinkles

avis.titre: 3.5 Stars - Hoping the Vitamin K Helps!
avis.texte: Unless you have a very specific skin tone and color of dark circle, this will not work as any type of concealer and I really wish the vitamin K formula was just a regular ol' eye cream. It does brighten my under eyes a little, but I find that it doesn't absorb/sit well under makeup and that it's also too shiny (for my personal preference) to wear without some type of powder over it. I WFH, so most days this doesn't matter and I'm hoping that the Vitamin K will be the saving grace of the product and will help lessen my dark circles over time.

avis.titre: I really wanted to love this product!
avis.texte: I was so excited to try this product and I was very excited until a few minutes later it irritated my eyes, I thought it was something else I have used but I keep trying it and every time I use it it burns my eyes it feels really bad to the point that I have to wipe it off my face because I can barely keep my eyes open. I love many of Naturium products I have many of them but this one is a no for me and I really hope they listen to these reviews (cause i'm not the only one with this problem) and that they fix the formula. other than that much love to Naturium
I love this cream, it makes me look like I have makeup on. My dark circles are GONE
I bought this couple of months ago after so much hype and review, I still didnt see the effect. Not for my skin type

I love this product, it does what it says. IF you are a frequent traveler i'd recomend a different eye product as this one liquified on me. I really debated writing this review (for a month) but i really wanted to put this out there. I'm not sure what the pressure or tempurature did, but i went to use this when i got home and it splashed all over my counter! LOL. Still buying more, just not flying with it.

avis.titre: High on shimmer and low on moisture and tint
avis.texte: I got this in the darker shade because it's more peachy, which is a better corrector shade for me. There's a minimal amount of tint in this, definitely not enough to correct or make a difference. Even though it has shea butter in it, the product didn't moisturize my dry undereye area well. You're left with tons and tons of shimmery mica deposited on your dry, dark undereye.

avis.titre: Not a bad eye cream, but it pills.
avis.texte: The eye cream itself is nice, but it pills terribly so you can't wear it under eye makeup which is disappointing. I also was allergic to an ingredient. It made my eyes puffy and red and itchy....other wise it did brighten under my eyes and it was very moisturizing.

Had great hopes for this eyecream . Its awful, after a few days of usung my under eyes are oeeling and so dry . Discontinued and moisturized undereyes have returned . FYI if you use a discount code for purchase items can not be returned, terrible return policy, I purchased 3 new itmes and all will end up in trash . Have my favorites but will no longer purchase.
I am liking this so far. I haven't used it long enough to give a full review, but so far so good for mature skin.

avis.titre: Eye cream checks all the boxes!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive eyes, and I had no issues with the eye cream. It felt good looked good and fairly priced!
It's like highlighter, and if you are men it looks like make up, it looks really bad. You can see the glitter.
Ive enjoyed the wye cream! The eye cream makes my eyes look bright!

I sit on the tail end of medium-light, sometimes (depending on the brand) I'm labeled medium when it comes to foundation. I have a cool undertone, and I would say this cream in the medium/deep shade is perfect for me. I'm mixed race, I have very dry, sensitive skin. I suffer with eczema, pretty severe post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation in the eye area, and I have very narrow deep-set eyes that extenuate the discoloration. This product looks beautiful. It helps reduce the appearance of the hyperpigmentation, and I've been able to use it in place of hydrocortisone ointment I was using to treat the eczema. My eyes never feel dry, and the moisture lasts all day as long as I don't wipe or wash it away. I've purchased it twice now. It lays beautifully under makeup. It's easy to use, and you don't need a lot to get great results. I've only been using it for close to 3 months now. I don't currently notice any fading of the discoloration itself, but I think the factors I've listed previously would make that a pretty impossible expectation to meet for a skincare product. Especially considering that I haven't used it that long. So I can't speak to long term effects. If I have the ability to update this review, I would gladly share more about the effects of long term use, but for now I'm really happy with my purchase.
My tired eyes are loving this cream. It's moisturizing and really does brighten.
I really can't say wow my dark circles are lighter or gone. Does it take time? I have used it less than a week

I bought this product as a woman that deals with slight undereye discoloration and endless freckles. Concealer hides my freckles and I wanted to find a product that wouldn't cover them up, but would brighten up my undereye. I will say, this product absolutely brightened my undereye. However, I just feel like it literally was a yellowy glow under my eyes. It appeared out of place almost. I'm sure this product is complementary for someone with a more even skin tone, just didn't happen to work for me.
I love the texture of this body butter. Not at all crazy about the scent. I know it is supposed to be fragrance free but it has a distinct odor.

I brought this for my daughter who has dark rings around her eyes, I saw the ad on tick too and it was impressive, I spoke with her and she's please I told her now you can sign up for auto pay each month 😂
I love the feel on my under eye. I should have gotten the darker one.

This is my literal favorite eye cream. I have gone through 2 jars and will be purchasing my third. Why do I swear by it? Because it's actually MOISTURIZING. So many eye creams are not moisturizing enough and leave my skin feeling dry after a few hours. I used to love the Summer Fridays eye cream but I think they reformulated because it's just not nourishing enough anymore. This Naturium one is thick and gets the job done and is less than half the price. I use the medium/deep shade, so I can't speak to the lighter shade.
It's nit bad. However from the videos I saw I expected quicker results
I love this product its is so beautiful to use. The cream is a easy new step in my beauty routine. I have only just started using it and already see improvements.

Amazing!! I have never had a product help my skin look and feel so amazing in 38years more than this brand. Rough bumpy skin, gone, texture improving each use and without toxic chemicals this product is simply life changing. Please do not change your products! I will be using Naturium for life.
I put this on after concealer and it helps blend in concealer so there are no creases. I have mature skin and this helps a lot with brightening the undereye.
Horrible doesn't work on my skin color nor does it do any coverage, I'm brown skin & got the medium color cream. Very disappointing for the amount of money spent not worth it at all.
I ordered the wrong color and immediately tried canceling,but they denied it. Returns are extremely difficult.

avis.titre: Vitamin Bright Illuminating Eye Cream - Light/Medi
avis.texte: OMG this eye cream worked really well and so quickly!!! I will definately purchase more. Very happy with my order.

Of all the Naturium products I've tried…and loved!…this one was the only fail for me. I really saw minimal moisturizing benefit and the product tended to 'travel', not optimal with an eye cream. It bothered and irritated my eyes and I'd end the day with sparkles scattered over the top of my cheeks. I tried it several times, hoping each time would be different, but nope. My eyes would be irritated and my cheeks would sparkle after a few hours. A rare fail, imo.
I tried the product and I see the bags under my eyes going away.
Loved the light texture. It brightens the under eye area right after application then it blends well into skin

avis.titre: Personally I enjoy refreshing eye creams
avis.texte: I really like this eye cream. It's soothing, illuminates (with very fine sparkles), it feels cooling and refreshing. Haven't been using it long enough to attest to any fine like reduction. Sits well under multiple concealers I've tried. Got it in the dark/medium. Looks darker in the jar than in the pictures, but doesn't do anything for color correcting my dark circles. I wanted to exchange it for the light, hoping it would help my dark circles on no makeup days, but realized they don't offer exchanges! So that's my reason for knocking off one star.
This actually does what it says. I have dark under eye circles and this not only nourishes but covers and leaves a nice glow.

I really wanted to love this but it does literally nothing. No illuminating effect so I gave it time because it says it lightens dark circles over time too but after 1.5 months there's no difference. Won't buy again.

I was expecting the pigment of this eye cream to be pinker. The color of this is tan. I have light medium skin with very dark under eye bags. Typically, I look for deep peach under eye brightener to cover my circles. The color of this eye cream is not pink or peach, it is neutral tan.

Really enjoying this product. Finding an eye product that doesn't irritate me can be a challenge, especially anything with coloring but this has gone on smoothly, the texture is great and I've had no negative reactions!

I love this product. It's very creamy and very hydrating. A little goes a long way. I've seen a difference using product consistently. If using under makeup just use the tiniest bit or it can separate my concealer a little bit. Other than that really loved the results. Also, be sure to rub or tap in the product enough so the yellow or orange color (depending on which color buy for your skin tone) doesn't leave a tint on the skin/under eye. Other than that I really like it and will be repurchasing.

I have been using this for about a week and I love it!! A lot of eye creams seem to irritate my eyes and this one does not. It goes on smooth and works well under my concealer. It has a nice light reflecting shimmer that makes the eye area look refreshed. I will definitely be purchasing this again.
I love the peptide duo. Both products go on my skin well and no issues.
This eye cream is amazing and does not give me a reaction. I have sensitive skin and I am so far loving this. Eyes look brighter
Great product as always! Its soothing under the eye and I love the light glow. No more cakey concealer!
Eye area is smoother after 1 week of using the product. Redness reduced.
I don't see any changes or improvement yet… here's hoping it will work over time.

avis.titre: This cream is amazing but you must be consistent.
avis.texte: I've always had dark circles around my eyes since my 20s. This eye cream works wonders but you have to be consistent with it to see results. I didn't notice a change until a few weeks after using it in the morning and at night. I personally use the deep tone. I do like the instant glow you get when using the cream. A little goes a long way too, you don't need a lot. I say go for if you want to try it. Just remember to be consistent.
Love this eye cream! It's so moisturizing and non-irritating.

I literally only put my hyaluronic acid serum on my eyes and whatever eye cream I'm using and I still get pilling when I just use this by itself. If I mix in with a aquaphor a blends in beautifully but I feel like as an eye cream you shouldn't have to blend anything in just for it to not pill, like I can put this on by itself and an hour later it's pilling and lifting. I think they need to reformulate it.

I do have a favorite eye cream, but decided to give this a try too because I have hereditary dark circles on my inner lower eye. Nothing has ever changed them, but this does slightly brighten my eye area when I don't have make up on at night. I have light olive skin and have tried both the light and medium/deep. For my dark circles, the medium/ deep is the one I see the most effect when I apply it. In attempt to see if I notice any longer term effects of using the vitamin k that I've read about, I've decided to use this cream at night. It's too early to report any long term change, but I do like the creams texture and moisturizing effects overall,as well as how the medium/ deep visibly brightens when I apply it.
New to using this product but it's been fantastic thus far! Applies amazingly under makeup and without.
I mainly purchase it because I read that Azelaic was good for redness and I have to say it works wonders on my skin. Gentle enough to use every day.

I've only had the eye cream for a few weeks, so I can't say anything about the long term benefits of this eye cream. My initial impressions are that the texture is very odd, almost chunky looking? It does give a nice brightening effect when applied though.
Feels moisturizing. Too early to determine if it brightens but upon application it just looks as if you applied lotion to me.
I hate the pot packaging but like the product so far! Love the reflecting pigment for no make up zoom calls
I do like the eye cream. I'm not sure if the coverage is enough, may try darker shade also. Goes on smooth and definitely feels like skincare also which is great!
It's ok, do not see any difference between my other eye creams and this one. I really wanted to love it!

It's a great product and it does everything it says it's going to do. But for me, it's pulling with my normal skincare routine. It's the only thing I added and my under eyes are pulling. I haven't given up on it though. I'll def keep trying it.
I wanted to love but very disappointed. It is not very illuminating and not moisturizing at all. It actually accentuates the fine lines under my eyes.
Goes on light, nice consistency, good skin care product. but there is another brand that I prefer for this because it is thicker and holds the color for longer.

avis.titre: If you're on the fence it's worth it!
avis.texte: Bought this a month ago and saw results within the first couples of uses. My dark circles have been getting worse since I've struggled with sleeping and this has made a huge difference. Love the texture, little goes a long way

With this extreme heat these products are not stable to maintain a four -six day delivery window. The product arrived and i opened it up to see the ingredients had separated. I put the product in the fridge with the hopes of saving it! Fingers crossed
I will continue to purchase this. I like that there's vitamin K and it's slightly tinted. I have under eye bags and while it's not a miracle product, I still feel like it does help slightly.
I expected a stronger brightening effect. It's very very subtle. It does feel nice though!

avis.titre: I wanted to love this product!!
avis.texte: Couldn't wait for this product to come out and ordered immediatly. On first application the skin around my eyes was on fire. I gave it a couple more days until I woke up with swollen crusty eyes. Clearly Im allergic to something in it. Also its doesn't spread smoothly it gets clumpy and if you apply too much it balls up. I love everything from this brand and am so bummed this product didn't work out. It does do a great job of illuminating under eyes.

I have loved these balms since they came out. They're the perfect marriage between skincare and makeup. Lovely tint and so hydrating and nourishing. These new shades are gorgeous, I truly love them all equally, I love using them over a lipliner for a day look and at night as an overnight balm. When I use them at night, I wake up with it still on my lips, truly the only lip product that stays on overnight and you wake up with plump lips. These are on steady rotation for me. The new shades are a bit more sheer than the first ones but I don't mind that at all. Great purchase, will continue to buy forever.

avis.titre: Love the texture of this eye cream!
avis.texte: The texture is nice and it actually brightens up my entire eye area, which I appreciate! It lays perfectly under concealer and spf, as well.
Love this product! I love the texture and the way it brightens my under eye.

Great so far! It's a nice gel cream consistency which I love in an eye cream. Not sure if notice the significant brightening from the Pearl pigments but I think I could use the lighter shade too on my Deep skin tone to see different results. Looking forward to future improvement.

I am really liking the product so far, but gave 3 stars as the container came half empty… I keep seeing that in reviews for other products so I really hope they pay attention and get these issues resolved so they don't lose customers when the products are great!
I love everything about Naturium. I have almost every one of her products but this eye cream did feel good on my eyes. I wanted to love it but it just didn't cut it for me.
Grainy and not hydrating. I had high execrations but was dry..
Prefer the peptide cream. I did not see much illumination effect
Just received my package but it doesn't seem to look like what I see in the pictures. Its sort of like the oil separated from the eye cream. Not sure If I have to mix it.
